_note: The customer survey's questions, shared by the /survey page and the printed survey card (src/studio/survey-card.njk), so the two always ask the same thing. Keep it short: every question added is a customer who stops halfway. `ratings` are tap-one-of-four (`short` heads /feedback's month table) on the page and circle-one on paper; `choices` are pick-one; `open` are free text. `name` is the field name in the email Formspree sends. `share` is the box that lets a comment go on the public /feedback page (with a first name at most); without it only the totals do. The kitchen PC's Survey import matches a typed-up sheet's headings to these names and labels, so renaming one means the next sheet uses the new wording.
